text: おれに　そんな　ものが　あったら　スロットで　あてほうだい　だぜ！

structure.jp: おれに　そんな　ものが　あったら
structure.en: if I had something like that

structure.jp: あてほうだい　だぜ！
structure.en: I could win as much as I liked!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' that happened. そんな　ものが　あったら = 'if I had something like that'.

patterns.name: 〜放題
patterns.explanation: ほうだい after a verb stem means doing it as much as you like, with no limit. あてほうだい = 'winning as much as I like'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly speech that pushes what was said. あてほうだい　だぜ = 'I'd win all I wanted, man'.
